dashboard.label: Leadership Overview
dashboard.description: High-level view of IOC matches, review coverage, and decision throughput for OpenCTI Threat Match.

search.query: index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:* earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval type=case( sourcetype="opencti:domain_match" OR sourcetype="opencti:domain_match_backfill","domain", sourcetype="opencti:ip_match" OR sourcetype="opencti:domain_answer_ip_match_backfill" OR sourcetype="opencti:domain_answer_ip_match","ip", sourcetype="opencti:url_match" OR sourcetype="opencti:url_match_backfill","url", sourcetype="opencti:file_hash_match" OR sourcetype="opencti:file_hash_match_backfill","hash", sourcetype="opencti:email_match" OR sourcetype="opencti:email_match_backfill","email", 1=1,"other") | eval indicator=case( type="domain", coalesce(match_value, fqdn, domain, ioc), type="ip", ip, type="url", coalesce(url_candidate, url, ioc), type="hash", hash, type="email", email, 1=1, ioc) | where isnotnull(indicator) AND indicator!="" | eval hits=if(isnum(hits), hits, 1) | stats sum(hits) as hits earliest(first_seen) as first_seen latest(last_seen) as last_seen latest(src_index) as src_index latest(labels) as labels by indicator type ioc | lookup opencti_seenbefore_kv indicator,type OUTPUT ioc_rating cleared decided_at decided_by note | where (isnull($type_filter$) OR $type_filter$="" OR type=$type_filter$) | where (isnull($bu_filter$) OR $bu_filter$="" OR like(labels, "%$bu_filter$%")) | eval Rating=coalesce(ioc_rating, "Unreviewed")
| eval reviewed=if(Rating!="Unreviewed", indicator, null()) | stats dc(reviewed) as Reviewed_IOCs
| eval unreviewed=if(Rating="Unreviewed", indicator, null()) | stats dc(unreviewed) as Unreviewed_IOCs
| eval cleared_ioc=if(cleared=1, indicator, null()) | stats dc(cleared_ioc) as Cleared_IOCs
| inputlookup opencti_seenbefore_kv | where isnotnull(decided_at) | eval _time=decided_at | eval rating=coalesce(ioc_rating,"Unreviewed") | timechart span=1d count by rating
| stats dc(indicator) as iocs by Rating | sort - iocs

| where Rating="Unreviewed" | eval "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | rename indicator AS Indicator type AS Type src_index AS Index | table Indicator Type hits Index "First Time Seen" "Last Time Seen" | sort - hits | head 25
| stats sum(hits) as hits dc(indicator) as iocs by src_index | sort - hits | head 15

| inputlookup opencti_seenbefore_kv | where isnotnull(decided_at) | eval _time=decided_at | eval Rating=coalesce(ioc_rating,"Unreviewed") | eval "Decided At"=strftime(decided_at, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | table indicator type Rating decided_by "Decided At" note | sort - "Decided At" | head 25

| where Rating="malicious" AND cleared=1 | eval seen_after_cleared=if(isnotnull(decided_at) AND last_seen>decided_at, "Yes","No") | eval "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | rename indicator AS Indicator type AS Type src_index AS Index | table Indicator Type hits Index seen_after_cleared "First Time Seen" "Last Time Seen" | sort - hits | head 25
